newsitem.title: UK: London shares open firm after Wall St record close.
newsitem.headline: London shares open firm after Wall St record close.

text.p: UK shares started higher on Wednesday with investors cheered by Wall Street's record finish on Tuesday.
The FTSE, within a whisker of its all-time intraday trading peak of 4,723.7, may fall short of that high today as worries about rising bond yields cap any advance, dealers said.

"The market makers have pushed up prices once again this morning but I don't think we'll see a lot of buyers," the head of sales and trading at a major investment bank said. "The market is looking a bit toppy."
The FTSE 100 was up 15.5 points to 4,697.1 by 0731 GMT.
